'''Tidjane Abdoul Salaün''' ({{IPA|fr|tidʒan salœ̃|lang}}; born 10 August 2005) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Charlotte Hornets]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He previously played for [[Cholet Basket]] of the [[LNB  Pro A]].

==Professional career==

=== Cholet Basket (2022–2024) ===
Salaün began playing for [[Cholet Basket]]'s youth team in LNB Espoirs, the French under-21 league, in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|title=Basket. Leray, Dufeal, Salaun, Bordes… la vie d'après des Espoirs de Cholet|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/cholet/basket-leray-dufeal-salaun-bordes-la-vie-dapres-des-espoirs-de-cholet-c9da9044-fdfd-11ed-a6e9-8b0f9ca2841f|work=[[Ouest-France]]|date=30 May 2023|access-date=16 October 2023|language=French}}</ref>
In February 2023, he was invited to take part in the [[NBA]]'s [[Basketball Without Borders]] camp during the [[2023 NBA All-Star Game|All-Star Game weekend]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Basket. Le Choletais Tidjane Salaun invité par la NBA à un camp réunissant 40 talents internationaux|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/cholet/basket-le-choletais-tidjane-salaun-invite-par-la-nba-a-un-camp-reunissant-40-talents-internationaux-2c1f251a-a897-11ed-aeeb-69381795ad8f|work=[[Ouest-France]]|date=9 February 2023|access-date=1 December 2023|language=French}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: France's Tidjane Salaun|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-frances-tidjane-salaun|website=[[SI.com]]|publisher=[[Sports Illustrated]]|date=2 October 2023|access-date=16 October 2023}}</ref>

In May of the same year, Salaün was named the MVP of the 2023 Trophée du Futur tournament, having averaged 17.7 points and 7.3 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite web|first=Mateo|last=Dufour|title=Trophée du Futur : à Blois, Tidjane Salaun a amorcé son décollage|url=https://www.lanouvellerepublique.fr/blois/trophee-du-futur-a-blois-tidjane-salaun-a-amorce-son-decollage|work=[[La Nouvelle République du Centre-Ouest]]|date=28 May 2023|access-date=1 December 2023|language=French}}</ref> He signed his first professional contract with Cholet's senior team on 10 July 2023.<ref>{{cite web|title=Basket. Cholet Basket signe pro sa pépite Tidjane Salaun : " Il sera la rotation du poste 3 "|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/cholet/basket-cholet-basket-signe-pro-sa-pepite-tidjane-salaun-il-sera-la-rotation-du-poste-3-6ce407f0-1f43-11ee-990b-509b31c26799|work=[[Ouest-France]]|date=10 July 2023|access-date=16 October 2023|language=French}}</ref>

During the [[2023–24 LNB Élite season|2023–24 season]], Salaün featured for Cholet Basket's senior team both in the [[LNB Élite]] and the [[2023-24 FIBA Champions League|FIBA Champions League]],<ref name=":0" /> and finished the campaign by averaging 9.6 points, 3.9 rebounds, and one steal per game.<ref name=":02">{{cite news|title=NBA Draft: French players Risacher, Sarr and Salaün make history in New York|url=https://www.lemonde.fr/en/sports/article/2024/06/27/france-s-risacher-chosen-by-hawks-with-top-pick-in-nba-draft_6675885_9.html|work=[[Le Monde]]|date=27 June 2024|access-date=27 June 2024}}</ref>

=== Charlotte Hornets (2024–present) ===
On 25 April 2024, Salaün announced that he had declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]];<ref name=":0" /> his entry was confirmed by the [[NBA]] on 2 May.<ref>{{cite web|title=NBA announces early entry candidates for NBA Draft 2024|url=https://www.nba.com/news/nba-draft-2024-early-entry-candidates|website=NBA.com|date=2 May 2024|access-date=27 June 2024}}</ref>

On 26 June 2024, Salaün was selected with the sixth overall pick by the [[Charlotte Hornets]] in the 2024 NBA draft.<ref name=":02" /><ref>{{cite web|first=Tim|last=Bontemps|title=Hawks use No. 1 pick on France's Risacher, 19|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/40440314/hawks-pick-france-zaccharie-risacher-no-1-nba-draft|work=[[ESPN]]|date=27 June 2024|access-date=27 June 2024}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{cite web|first=Gaëtan|last=Delafolie|title=Risacher et Sarr au sommet, Salaün dans le top 10 : draft NBA historique pour la France|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Risacher-n-1-sarr-n-2-draft-nba-historique-pour-la-france/1477805|work=[[L'Équipe]]|date=27 June 2024|access-date=27 June 2024|language=fr-FR}}</ref> He was picked alongside fellow Frenchmen [[Zaccharie Risacher]] (drafted by the [[Atlanta Hawks]] with the [[List of first overall NBA draft picks|first overall pick]]) and [[Alex Sarr]] (drafted by the [[Washington Wizards]] with the second pick), making France the first foreign nation to have at least three native players picked in the top 10 spots of any NBA draft.<ref name=":02" /><ref name=":1" /> He was the second youngest player from his draft class. On 3 July 2024, he signed with the Hornets.<ref>{{cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Sign Tidjane Salaün|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/charlotte-hornets-sign-tidjane-salaun|website=NBA.com|date=3 July 2024|access-date=4 July 2024}}</ref> He made his summer league debut on July 13 against the [[New York Knicks]] with the Charlotte Hornets winning 94–90. He scored 8 points, grabbed 7 rebounds, and dished out an assist in 14 minutes of play. On 18 January 2025, he was [[NBA G League#Standard assignment|assigned]] to the [[Greensboro Swarm]].<ref>{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Charlotte Hornets Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/nba/teams/Charlotte-Hornets/3/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=3 February 2025}}</ref>

==National team career==
Salaün played for the [[France men's national under-19 basketball team|France national under-18 team]] in the [[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship]].<ref>{{cite web|title=La France éliminée par l'Espagne en demi-finales de l'Euro U18|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/La-france-eliminee-par-l-espagne-en-demi-finales-de-l-euro-u18/1410920|work=[[L'Équipe]]|date=29 July 2023|access-date=1 December 2023|language=French}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Salaün's parents both played basketball. His sister, [[Janelle Salaün]], played in the [[EuroLeague Women]] and for the [[France women's national basketball team|France women's national team]]. She now plays for the [[Golden State Valkyries]] expansion team. <ref name=":0">{{cite web|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|title=French teen Tidjane Salaun submits paperwork to enter NBA draft|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/40022074/french-teen-tidjane-salaun-submits-paperwork-enter-nba-draft|website=ESPN.com|date=25 April 2024|access-date=27 May 2024}}</ref> He is of [[Guadeloupe]]an descent.<ref>{{cite web|title=NBA: deux joueurs guadeloupéens draftés|url=https://www.guadeloupe.franceantilles.fr/actualite/sports/nba-tidjane-salaun-et-melvin-ajinca-draftes-992996.php|website=guadeloupe.franceantilles.fr|date=6 February 2024|access-date=19 January 2025}}</ref>
